description:
The Operations team helps the business and its partner teams run effectively day-to-day by turning operational data into decision support and replacing manual administrative friction with automated, scalable systems.

We are seeking a highly analytical, detail-oriented Data & Operations Analyst for a fixed-term contract. Unlike a traditional maternity cover focused on maintaining the status quo, this role is explicitly dedicated to driving innovation. Reporting directly to the Senior Manager of Operations, you will play a hands-on role in building out dashboards, standardising complex workflows, and automating repetitive tasks across the organisation. You will thrive here if you are a self-starter who excels at following complex instructions but possesses the out-of-the-box thinking required to suggest and implement your own process improvements.

Gaining exposure to enterprise-level operations, working directly with a Senior Manager to build systems that impact the entire business, you will leave this role with a portfolio of automated workflows, high-impact dashboards, and tangible efficiency wins.

Compensation range: 120,000 to 140,000 RON gross annual salary

The actual salary offer to the successful candidate will be based on job-related education, training, licensure, certifications, related experience and other related factors

What you will be doing

  • Data Visualisation & Reporting: Assist in the design, build, and maintenance of high-visibility operational and people-data dashboards to give leaders a clear view of statistics, progress, risks, and performance.
  • Process Automation: Identify repetitive, manual workflows across cross-functional teams and assist in building automated solutions, utilising tools like Power Automate, Power Apps, AppScript to eliminate administrative bottlenecks.
  • Process Standardisation: Document and standardise operating procedures, templates, and guidance to ensure consistent ways of working across the business.
  • Data Integrity & Analysis: Act as a meticulous steward of data accuracy for critical business systems (including Jira, Tempo, Google Workspace, SharePoint and Salesforce), identifying anomalies and ensuring reporting logic is flawless before it reaches the executive level.
  • Internal Tooling Support: Help maintain and troubleshoot custom internal tools (such as SharePoint and Power Apps solutions, Canvas Apps, Looker Studio), turning recurring user issues into systemic process improvements.
  • Strategic Ideation: Proactively analyse current operational frameworks to uncover blind spots, proposing fresh, outside-the-box ideas to streamline operations.
  • May be accountable for other results and activities as assigned

Requirements

  • Strong baseline experience in data analysis, reporting, and manipulating datasets
  • Familiarity with data visualisation tools (Power BI, Looker Studio) and strong proficiency in advanced Excel/Google Sheets
  • Exposure to automation tools (Power Automate, Power Apps) or collaboration platforms (Jira, SharePoint, Smartsheet)
  • Track record of documenting, standardising, or improving work processes
  • Experience translating technical data or complex processes into clear language for stakeholders
  • Technical Background 
  • Degree-level qualification or equivalent experience


A pioneer in voluntary collective licensing, CCC is a leading information solutions provider to organizations around the world. CCC works to advance copyright, accelerate knowledge, and power innovation. CCC helps organizations harness the power of data, AI, and machine learning to drive strategic decision-making, grow their businesses, and gain competitive advantage.

When you join CCC, you become part of a dynamic organization strengthened by our community.  We care about our team members and clients.  We strive to create advanced technology in a vibrant, innovative culture.  CCC provides excellent benefits.
